# `kernel/fs/miscfs/union` — the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — miscfs/union

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — miscfs/union.

`config.mk` records 3 source file(s) here: `union_subr.c`, `union_vfsops.c`, `union_vnops.c`.

Subdirectories: `libc/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
